_comment: One finding record, matching the schema in Volume I §5. Findings live as an array in audit/03-findings.json — one object per check, all 119 present. A check with no standing_control cannot be recorded as PASS.
title: Core application security
probe: What you actually did to find out what is true — the command, the request, the attack.
evidence: Concrete, checkable artifacts: file paths, line ranges, request/response pairs, run identifiers.
Not impressions. Not 'appears to'. An assertion with no artifact behind it is NO-EVIDENCE.

clone_sweep.pattern: The repository-wide search that proves this defect class has no survivors.
clone_sweep.note: A finding stays open while a clone of it remains.

structural_fix.description: The refactor that makes the defect unrepresentable rather than detectable.
structural_fix.declined_reason: If not taken, say why here — and register the standing control that runs forever instead. A 'no' arrived at by default rather than by decision is itself a finding.

standing_control.mechanism: The permanent machinery that keeps this true after the audit leaves.
standing_control.ratchet: The metric that may never regress (S11).
standing_control.calibration: How the control is itself re-proven (S12).
standing_control.demonstrated: Evidence you WATCHED it block something: re-introduce the defect, record the refusal. A control you have not seen fire is a control you are hoping about.

verification.failing_test: The test that went red before the fix.
verification.independent_verifier: Model/vendor that did not write the fix and tried to falsify it.
verification.gate_decision: The deterministic gate's verdict — not a model's opinion.
